items.title: Architecture checklist for an AI-provider abstraction in ASP.NET Core
items.summary: A reusable checklist for keeping model providers replaceable without hiding provider-specific capabilities.
items.content: Define task-level routes, expose provider capabilities, enforce timeouts and cancellation, keep secrets in environment variables, capture usage metadata, validate structured output, and retain a deterministic fallback for local development.
items.author: Satya
items.notes: Internal seed note. Add links to verified external sources before using factual claims.

items.title: Threat-model questions for a local .NET MCP server
items.summary: Questions to ask before exposing tools, prompts, or resources from an MCP server.
items.content: What is the trust boundary? Which operations require explicit consent? How are tool inputs validated? Which resources may contain untrusted instructions? What is logged, redacted, rate-limited, and reversible?
items.author: Satya
items.notes: Internal seed note. Treat it as an outline, not an external source.

items.title: A senior-engineer lens for turning tech news into useful content
items.summary: A content signal is more valuable when it is connected to a decision, trade-off, experiment, and measurable result.
items.content: For each signal: verify the source, name the engineering decision it could affect, identify assumptions, design a reversible experiment, define quality and operational measures, and share limitations alongside the takeaway.
